units.title: Canonical project roadmap and agent instructions
scope: Commit approved machine-readable plan, architecture, repository instructions, and stable work-unit naming.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Roadmap is valid, counted from actual milestones, and readable by existing Engine Room importers.
verification: Roadmap is valid, counted from actual milestones, and readable by existing Engine Room importers.

units.title: TypeScript application skeleton and CI
scope: Initialize Next.js API/UI, shared typed package, formatting, lint, tests, and GitHub Actions.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Fresh checkout builds and tests; deliberate failing check blocks merging.
verification: Fresh checkout builds and tests; deliberate failing check blocks merging.

units.title: Minimal authenticated arrival endpoint
scope: Expose a private minimal check-in endpoint and idempotent arrival acknowledgment for temporary sessions.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated request creates a traceable arrival; unauthenticated and replayed requests are rejected or deduplicated.
verification: Authenticated request creates a traceable arrival; unauthenticated and replayed requests are rejected or deduplicated.

units.title: Live ChatGPT scheduled-execution feasibility gate
scope: Demonstrate one real scheduled ChatGPT task invoking the Boardroom integration, receiving an assignment, and reporting a result; record connector limits.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Evidence from a real scheduled run documents what works and any approval pauses; no synthetic run passes this gate.
verification: Evidence from a real scheduled run documents what works and any approval pauses; no synthetic run passes this gate.

units.title: Supported provider connector or external-runner fallback
scope: Implement a custom supported tool/app interface if available; otherwise a clearly labeled hosted-worker activation path with identical agent instructions.
units.acceptanceCriteria: At least one supported unattended execution route invokes the API and is demonstrably usable; unsupported routes remain disabled.
verification: At least one supported unattended execution route invokes the API and is demonstrably usable; unsupported routes remain disabled.

units.title: Neon schema, migrations, and transaction outbox
scope: Create migrations and domain types for repositories, sessions, leases, work units, owner requests, discussions, checkpoints, and outbox.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Clean and incremental migration tests pass; transaction rollback leaves no orphan assignments.
verification: Clean and incremental migration tests pass; transaction rollback leaves no orphan assignments.

units.title: Owner authentication and restricted administration
scope: Protect owner endpoints and private application, add roles and strong session controls, audit security changes.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Anonymous and agent credentials cannot access owner data or modify administrative controls.
verification: Anonymous and agent credentials cannot access owner data or modify administrative controls.

units.title: Scoped GitHub App onboarding
scope: Implement GitHub App installation/read permissions, repository access discovery, webhook verification foundation, and credential rotation.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Can securely enumerate allowed repositories and fetch authoritative metadata without embedding a personal token.
verification: Can securely enumerate allowed repositories and fetch authoritative metadata without embedding a personal token.

units.title: Repository inventory and rename-safe identity
scope: Import registered repositories using immutable numeric GitHub IDs; track archived, disabled, and restricted repositories.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A repo rename preserves its identity, history, priority, and prior assignments.
verification: A repo rename preserves its identity, history, priority, and prior assignments.

units.title: Canonical roadmap/PR-registry adapter
scope: Read existing registry/roadmap.json and registry/prs.json contracts with explicit precedence, validation, and conflict diagnostics.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Conflicting or invalid sources fail visibly; historical plan counts and work-unit IDs are preserved.
verification: Conflicting or invalid sources fail visibly; historical plan counts and work-unit IDs are preserved.

units.title: Verified work-unit and dependency eligibility
scope: Calculate which approved PR units are actionable, merged, blocked, or await prerequisite work.
units.acceptanceCriteria: No new tasks are fabricated and already completed work is never silently reassigned.
verification: No new tasks are fabricated and already completed work is never silently reassigned.

units.title: Ordered owner priority repositories list
scope: Create private edit/reorder APIs for the owner-maintained priority list.
units.acceptanceCriteria: First available top-ranked priority repository wins over every ordinary repository.
verification: First available top-ranked priority repository wins over every ordinary repository.

units.title: Authoritative least-recently-updated comparator
scope: Derive latest genuine development event from GitHub, with creation-date fallback and deterministic tie-breaks.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Oldest eligible nonpriority repo is chosen; local refresh timestamps do not affect ordering.
verification: Oldest eligible nonpriority repo is chosen; local refresh timestamps do not affect ordering.

units.title: Stateless identical-prompt session admission
scope: Generate a new unique run ID for every scheduled arrival; do not require customized per-task instructions or retained agent memory.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Two identical prompts from different accounts can safely start independent sessions.
verification: Two identical prompts from different accounts can safely start independent sessions.

units.title: Optional activation-source metadata and replay protection
scope: Record provider and nonsecret source/schedule identifiers when available; permit unidentifiable-but-authenticated ephemeral runs.
units.acceptanceCriteria: No false account-wide singleton; duplicate delivery is idempotent where verified invocation identity exists.
verification: No false account-wide singleton; duplicate delivery is idempotent where verified invocation identity exists.

units.title: Atomic exclusive repository assignment
scope: Claim an eligible repository transactionally with a unique owner, generation counter, and race-safe row locking.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Hundreds of simultaneous claims yield at most one active owner for each repository.
verification: Hundreds of simultaneous claims yield at most one active owner for each repository.

units.title: Leases, heartbeats, and session renewal
scope: Define server-clock lease expiry, bounded heartbeat intervals, and renewal authorization.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Expired or unknown sessions cannot renew; healthy sessions retain their assignment.
verification: Expired or unknown sessions cannot renew; healthy sessions retain their assignment.

units.title: Session states, outcomes, and idempotent release
scope: Implement RUNNING, YIELDED, COMPLETED, BLOCKED, RECOVERING, FAILED, and UNKNOWN transitions with audit history.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate completion is harmless; release never frees a newer session's lease.
verification: Duplicate completion is harmless; release never frees a newer session's lease.

units.title: Repository selection conformance suite
scope: Test strict priority-first selection, oldest-update fallback, simultaneous claims, ties, and idling.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Deterministic cases and high-contention integration tests all pass.
verification: Deterministic cases and high-contention integration tests all pass.

units.title: Blocked repository and recovery-eligibility policies
scope: Prevent repeated selection of unrecoverable work while preserving automatic retries after blockers clear.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Blocked repositories leave the eligible pool with auditable reasons and become eligible after verification.
verification: Blocked repositories leave the eligible pool with auditable reasons and become eligible after verification.

units.title: Owner action relational model and states
scope: Create durable owner actions with repository/work unit, blockers, required human authority, severity, costs, and lifecycle.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Every request has a unique ID, creator session, immutable audit history, and status transitions.
verification: Every request has a unique ID, creator session, immutable audit history, and status transitions.

units.title: Agent escalation and owner-only classifier
scope: Define which unmet conditions require an owner rather than Coffee Corner or autonomous troubleshooting.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Agent cannot ask owner for a task another authorized agent can perform; genuinely human-only blockers are posted.
verification: Agent cannot ask owner for a task another authorized agent can perform; genuinely human-only blockers are posted.

units.title: Action templates for accounts, credentials, purchases, and approvals
scope: Provide structured actionable requests with exact target systems, minimum permissions, prerequisites, expected expense, and verification.
units.acceptanceCriteria: An example GitHub token/account/purchase request is specific, concise, and secret-free.
verification: An example GitHub token/account/purchase request is specific, concise, and secret-free.

units.title: Duplicate merging and blocker aggregation
scope: Deduplicate requests for the same missing key, provider account, approval, or configuration prerequisite across repositories.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Multiple agents needing one prerequisite generate one owner card with all affected projects listed.
verification: Multiple agents needing one prerequisite generate one owner card with all affected projects listed.

units.title: Private Owner Action Board inbox
scope: Implement a single owner dashboard for outstanding, blocked, awaiting verification, complete, and declined actions.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Owner can sort, filter, inspect, and change action state without opening individual chat windows.
verification: Owner can sort, filter, inspect, and change action state without opening individual chat windows.

units.title: Owner action detail and evidence view
scope: Display step-by-step instructions, exact requested secret name or scope, affected repositories, links, urgency, and reason.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A user can carry out an action without asking which permission or destination is required.
verification: A user can carry out an action without asking which permission or destination is required.

units.title: Secure credentials and external-account handoff
scope: Use secret-store references or scoped platform secret-entry flows, with presence/capability verification; never put values in chat, logs, DB plaintext, or public GitHub.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Secret values never appear in Boardroom messages; agents receive only scoped capabilities and verification outcome.
verification: Secret values never appear in Boardroom messages; agents receive only scoped capabilities and verification outcome.

units.title: Owner approval boundaries and purchase controls
scope: Implement explicit approvals for spending, destructive actions, privilege changes, legal/political risks, and production release gates.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Unapproved risky actions cannot be executed even when a scheduled run attempts them.
verification: Unapproved risky actions cannot be executed even when a scheduled run attempts them.

units.title: Resolution, verify-and-requeue, and decline handling
scope: When an owner completes an action, validate fulfillment and automatically re-enable affected work; support clarification and rejection.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A verified completed secret/account task unblocks all dependent repositories without manual prompts to agents.
verification: A verified completed secret/account task unblocks all dependent repositories without manual prompts to agents.

units.title: Action notifications, batching, and safe audit trail
scope: Generate consolidated owner summaries, age-based reminders, redaction, and one-click action references.
units.acceptanceCriteria: No repetitive duplicate alerts and no personally sensitive material in emailed notification bodies.
verification: No repetitive duplicate alerts and no personally sensitive material in emailed notification bodies.

units.title: Repository context assembler
scope: Load AGENTS.md, canonical approved units, historical decisions, dependency status, current branches, and checkpoints.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Any new model run can understand and resume a repo without chat memory.
verification: Any new model run can understand and resume a repo without chat memory.

units.title: Provider-neutral tool protocol and typed SDK
scope: Expose standard claim, context, checkpoint, question, owner-action, and completion tools via versioned API/MCP or equivalent.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Provider SDKs pass schema, authorization, and negative conformance tests.
verification: Provider SDKs pass schema, authorization, and negative conformance tests.

units.title: Isolated coding execution harness
scope: Provide a short-lived sandbox/worktree or supported hosted worker with bounded compute and revocable access.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A live worker checks out its assigned repo, executes tests, and is terminated on cancellation.
verification: A live worker checks out its assigned repo, executes tests, and is terminated on cancellation.

units.title: Fenced GitHub write gateway
scope: Route privileged writes through an authorizer validating repo, run, permission, current generation, and expected refs.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Old, unauthorized, or cross-repository sessions cannot push or merge through Boardroom.
verification: Old, unauthorized, or cross-repository sessions cannot push or merge through Boardroom.

units.title: Safe branch management and write idempotency
scope: Create/reuse deterministic per-unit branches, avoid duplicate commits, check SHA preconditions, and handle conflicts.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Retried operations do not duplicate branches or overwrite concurrently updated refs.
verification: Retried operations do not duplicate branches or overwrite concurrently updated refs.

units.title: Work-unit-linked PR creation and updates
scope: Create PRs titled with stable Boardroom roadmap IDs; update existing PRs rather than generating duplicates.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Exact ID matching links real GitHub PRs to approved units and preserves canonical denominator.
verification: Exact ID matching links real GitHub PRs to approved units and preserves canonical denominator.

units.title: CI, test, and acceptance-evidence collector
scope: Ingest authoritative check suites, test status, unit acceptance, and timestamps with provenance.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Failing tests prohibit a false completion or automatic merge.
verification: Failing tests prohibit a false completion or automatic merge.

units.title: Review and safe merge policy engine
scope: Enforce protected-branch checks, required reviews, compatibility conditions, and owner-only exceptions.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Only correctly authorized green PRs can merge; bypass attempts are denied and logged.
verification: Only correctly authorized green PRs can merge; bypass attempts are denied and logged.

units.title: Continuous eligible PR-chain workflow
scope: After a verified unit finishes, pick the next approved eligible unit in the same claimed repo without user prompting.
units.acceptanceCriteria: One session may complete successive PR units while never taking a second repository.
verification: One session may complete successive PR units while never taking a second repository.

units.title: Durable Git checkpoints and handoff manifest
scope: Persist branch/head SHA, tests, remaining work, retry info, links, and code pushed remotely.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Another independent session can find every unfinished change and its next action.
verification: Another independent session can find every unfinished change and its next action.

units.title: Cross-session resume and interruption handling
scope: Detect existing draft work, resume by approved work-unit ID, and yield safely at execution limits.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A new scheduled ChatGPT/provider run resumes real incomplete code without the original chat.
verification: A new scheduled ChatGPT/provider run resumes real incomplete code without the original chat.

units.title: Real scheduled-task-to-GitHub end-to-end trial
scope: Demonstrate scheduled arrival, claim, working code change, test, mapped PR, checkpoint, and release in an authorized test repo.
units.acceptanceCriteria: End-to-end evidence includes real run, assignment, PR, CI, and finish timestamps; synthetic demo is insufficient.
verification: End-to-end evidence includes real run, assignment, PR, CI, and finish timestamps; synthetic demo is insufficient.

units.title: Cross-repository compatibility dependency planner
scope: Record producer/consumer contracts and versioned migrations; gate incompatible cross-project changes.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A breaking shared API migration blocks incompatible merges until an approved transition is verified.
verification: A breaking shared API migration blocks incompatible merges until an approved transition is verified.

units.title: Threaded engineering collaboration schema
scope: Store scoped project threads, questions, messages, status, linked PRs and responsible work units.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Messages remain searchable and associated with verifiable engineering subjects.
verification: Messages remain searchable and associated with verifiable engineering subjects.

units.title: Search-before-asking knowledge retrieval
scope: Search existing threads, repository ADRs, and relevant code/doc references before posting a duplicate question.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Agent receives relevant prior resolutions without relying on previous chat memory.
verification: Agent receives relevant prior resolutions without relying on previous chat memory.

units.title: Project-scoped question workflow
scope: Permit an agent to post a concrete question with blocker classification, evidence, and optional deadline.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Questions are readable in English and never require other agents to stop ongoing work.
verification: Questions are readable in English and never require other agents to stop ongoing work.

units.title: Evidence-based peer-answer workflow
scope: Allow agents to answer questions only within documented relevant work knowledge, with links and uncertainty disclosure.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Unsupported claims are distinguishable from source-backed engineering answers.
verification: Unsupported claims are distinguishable from source-backed engineering answers.

units.title: Asynchronous help and automatic unblock
scope: Track answered questions, integrate accepted answers into blocked work eligibility, and notify next eligible session.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A useful answer makes the work resumable without a human chat intervention.
verification: A useful answer makes the work resumable without a human chat intervention.

units.title: Architecture deliberation and repository ADR persistence
scope: Document meaningful technical decisions in GitHub ADRs, not chat alone; respect owner approval boundaries.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Every accepted architectural change has a durable repository reference and compatibility checks.
verification: Every accepted architectural change has a durable repository reference and compatibility checks.

units.title: End-of-session Coffee Corner service step
scope: After finishing real work and checkpointing, answer bounded unanswered qualified questions before departure.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Completed session makes a best-effort peer-help pass without extending forever or leaking the lease.
verification: Completed session makes a best-effort peer-help pass without extending forever or leaking the lease.

units.title: Discussion privacy, moderation, and prompt-injection controls
scope: Apply project-scope access, personal-data and secret scanning, retention policy, rate limiting, and distrust of instructions in messages.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Sensitive fixtures are blocked/redacted; chat messages cannot elevate agents' privileges.
verification: Sensitive fixtures are blocked/redacted; chat messages cannot elevate agents' privileges.

units.title: Deterministic watchdog and stalled-session detection
scope: Monitor runner health, heartbeat age, idling, stuck approvals, and sessions over budget.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Health classification never claims RUNNING from a stale heartbeat alone.
verification: Health classification never claims RUNNING from a stale heartbeat alone.

units.title: Verified process cancellation and recovery hold
scope: Terminate or isolate old execution before writable reassignment; provide recovery hold for unknown termination.
units.acceptanceCriteria: No second authorized writable process starts while the original can still write.
verification: No second authorized writable process starts while the original can still write.

units.title: Stale-session fencing and takeover race tests
scope: Prove lease generations are checked at every privileged write and cancellation race.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A late original worker is rejected after safe takeover even under injected latency.
verification: A late original worker is rejected after safe takeover even under injected latency.

units.title: Transactional outbox dispatcher and operation ledger
scope: Persist intended dispatch and GitHub side effects before execution, with idempotency keys and crash replay.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Crash between DB commit and queue submission loses no assignment; retry causes no duplicate write.
verification: Crash between DB commit and queue submission loses no assignment; retry causes no duplicate write.

units.title: Retry policies, backoff, and dead-letter handling
scope: Classify transient provider/API failures versus permanent blockers with bounded retry budgets.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Rate limits cause jittered retries; persistent errors create visible incidents and do not loop forever.
verification: Rate limits cause jittered retries; persistent errors create visible incidents and do not loop forever.

units.title: GitHub webhook ingestion with signatures and deduplication
scope: Ingest authenticated PR, push, repository, and workflow events with delivery IDs.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate/out-of-order deliveries cannot regress verified project state.
verification: Duplicate/out-of-order deliveries cannot regress verified project state.

units.title: Periodic authoritative GitHub reconciliation
scope: Reconcile missed webhooks and source freshness while respecting rate limits and conditional requests.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Real GitHub state repairs missing webhook updates without snapshot freshness being misrepresented.
verification: Real GitHub state repairs missing webhook updates without snapshot freshness being misrepresented.

units.title: Operational metrics, diagnostics, and alert routing
scope: Expose queue latency, throughput, stale leases, error rate, retry frequency, budget usage, and source freshness.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Failures have actionable root-cause and evidence links; owner is not spammed by repeated symptoms.
verification: Failures have actionable root-cause and evidence links; owner is not spammed by repeated symptoms.

units.title: Concurrency and chaos acceptance test suite
scope: Simulate simultaneous arrivals, process death, missed heartbeats, provider outages, webhook replay, and restarts.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Exclusive assignment, safe recovery, and durable progress pass repeatable fault injection.
verification: Exclusive assignment, safe recovery, and durable progress pass repeatable fault injection.

units.title: Private Boardroom UI shell and navigation
scope: Build responsive authenticated navigation for Work Board, Coffee Corner, Owner Actions, Operations, and audit.
units.acceptanceCriteria: All private views deny unauthorized access and work on desktop/mobile.
verification: All private views deny unauthorized access and work on desktop/mobile.

units.title: Live repository Work Board and priority editor
scope: Show repository availability, current assignment, work ID, last actual update, and editable priority order.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Refresh accurately reflects live leases and priority changes without stale status confusion.
verification: Refresh accurately reflects live leases and priority changes without stale status confusion.

units.title: Unified Owner Action Board UX
scope: Provide action templates, affected-project grouping, secure instructions, verify/reopen, and owner approval interface.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Owner can find and complete all pending manual requests in one private view.
verification: Owner can find and complete all pending manual requests in one private view.

units.title: Coffee Corner UX and discussion search
scope: Build threaded work-only discussion interface with source references and question state.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Owner can observe and search all authorized engineering discussions; agents can participate through API.
verification: Owner can observe and search all authorized engineering discussions; agents can participate through API.

units.title: Agent sessions, recovery, and event timeline
scope: Display ephemeral runs, originating provider when known, checkpoints, Git events, time spent, error provenance, and audit.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Reports distinguish scheduled activation from actual code work and verified completion.
verification: Reports distinguish scheduled activation from actual code work and verified completion.

units.title: Owner operational controls and priority overrides
scope: Add safe pause/resume, cancel, priority reorder, budget change, disable provider, and hold/recover actions.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Owner changes are RBAC-checked, auditable, and cannot accidentally release an active fenced worker.
verification: Owner changes are RBAC-checked, auditable, and cannot accidentally release an active fenced worker.

units.title: Engine Room read-only operational integration
scope: Publish versioned health/assignment API and add compatible Engine Room presentation without writing PR progress manually.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Engine Room shows Boardroom execution data separately from GitHub-derived roadmap progress.
verification: Engine Room shows Boardroom execution data separately from GitHub-derived roadmap progress.

units.title: Overnight summary and consolidated digests
scope: Summarize verified PRs, commits, tests, deployments, blocking Owner Actions, failures, and next priorities.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Single digest links to evidence and does not confuse model claims with observed GitHub facts.
verification: Single digest links to evidence and does not confuse model claims with observed GitHub facts.

units.title: Multi-account ChatGPT scheduled-task onboarding
scope: Document one identical task prompt and provider connection steps; verify 5-account/50-task-style arrivals without requiring numbered instructions.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Independent overlapping scheduled arrivals cooperate under repository leases and owner can audit real sessions.
verification: Independent overlapping scheduled arrivals cooperate under repository leases and owner can audit real sessions.

units.title: Claude scheduled-agent adapter
scope: Implement supported Claude-origin activation and tool interoperability without privileged shortcuts.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Claude sessions pass the same claim, code, checkpoint, and end tests as the primary adapter.
verification: Claude sessions pass the same claim, code, checkpoint, and end tests as the primary adapter.

units.title: Grok scheduled-agent adapter
scope: Implement supported Grok-origin activation and tool interoperability without privileged shortcuts.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Grok sessions pass the same claim, code, checkpoint, and end tests as the primary adapter.
verification: Grok sessions pass the same claim, code, checkpoint, and end tests as the primary adapter.

units.title: Provider conformance and capability registry
scope: Publish provider capability checks, error contracts, version negotiation, execution limits, and unsupported-path behavior.
units.acceptanceCriteria: New provider adapters cannot register as writable until all mandatory conformance tests pass.
verification: New provider adapters cannot register as writable until all mandatory conformance tests pass.

units.title: Large-scale scheduling and concurrency benchmark
scope: Load test 500+ registered activation sources, hundreds of arrival requests, and contention across many repositories.
units.acceptanceCriteria: No artificial ten-agent limit, no double claims, measured latency/error/cost under documented capacity.
verification: No artificial ten-agent limit, no double claims, measured latency/error/cost under documented capacity.

units.title: Per-session and aggregate usage/budget guardrails
scope: Track tokens, model charges, platform compute, quotas, and owner-configured thresholds.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Over-budget jobs safely checkpoint/yield; charges are visible and never silently increased.
verification: Over-budget jobs safely checkpoint/yield; charges are visible and never silently increased.

units.title: Security hardening, privacy review, and threat tests
scope: Harden RLS, webhooks, credentials, write gateway, audit retention, abuse controls, and owner-action redaction.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Cross-tenant/provider, prompt-injection, secret-exposure, and privilege-escalation tests fail closed.
verification: Cross-tenant/provider, prompt-injection, secret-exposure, and privilege-escalation tests fail closed.

units.title: Backup, point-in-time restore, and disaster recovery
scope: Implement verified backup/restore of Neon coordination state and retention of GitHub handoff references.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Fresh recovery environment restores assignments as safely unowned/reconciling, never blindly active.
verification: Fresh recovery environment restores assignments as safely unowned/reconciling, never blindly active.

units.title: Production deployments and service-capacity runbook
scope: Document Render/Neon topology, webhook URLs, zero-downtime migration, resource capacity, incident rollback, and onboarding.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Reproducible staging-to-production deployment with health and rollback evidence.
verification: Reproducible staging-to-production deployment with health and rollback evidence.

units.title: Final unattended multi-agent acceptance and audit
scope: Demonstrate production-like real scheduled workers, priority selection, one-per-repo, PR chaining, Coffee, owner escalation, crash recovery, and reports.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Evidence-linked acceptance matrix passes; no claim of production completion until verified on live integrations.
verification: Evidence-linked acceptance matrix passes; no claim of production completion until verified on live integrations.

units.title: Owner-approved agent display-name roster and canonical registry
scope: Store all owner-supplied names exactly in a complete human-readable document and a machine-readable allowlist; test count, uniqueness and punctuation.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Every owner-submitted name appears exactly once and remains stable; invalid or altered names are not silently accepted.
verification: Repository tests confirm a one-to-one correspondence between document and canonical JSON names.

units.title: Credential-bound recurring agent names, enforcement and API identity
scope: Bind each scheduled-task credential to one approved stable display name at registration; reject unknown names at admission; return server-verified name and runId; add validation tests and registration guidance.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Claimed names never authenticate a session by themselves; valid named credential resolves consistently across activations; unauthorized names are denied and credential identity cannot be overridden.
verification: Tests verify exact-case approved names, invalid names, repeated activations, impersonation attempts, and no secrets in public source.
